_comment: GitHub Codespace dev environment for TinyMalariaNet (Phase 1). Provisioned by the Reopen in Container button; matches the versions in requirements.txt.
name: tinymalaria-codespace
postCreateCommand: pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq unrar-free unrar || true) && python -c "import torch, cv2, onnxruntime, gradio, rarfile; print('TinyMalariaNet deps OK')"
